description: This file defines the Command struct and associated methods for handling command objects in the Mattermost server, including validation, sanitization, and audit information.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command with properties such as trigger, URL, method, and metadata, along with methods for validation, sanitization, and audit info.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of command properties for auditing purposes.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the command object, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the command object before saving, generating IDs and timestamps.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates the timestamp before updating the command.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Removes sensitive or non-persistent data from the command object.
